title: The Hidden Space and Gui Yan
summary: After 24 days on the eighth floor, Lin Dong becomes a 3rd Seal Symbol Master and uses Huasheng Light for the first time. His Destiny Symbol is pulled into the tower's legendary hidden space, where Little Mink finally wakes, with a new colour that it calls its true form. Little Mink explains the eight Ancestral Symbols, formed by the rules of heaven and earth, and says the room holds only a rubbing of one. The rubbing gives Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol a map of the Great Yan Dynasty showing the locations of two Ancestral Symbols, which Little Mink tells him to keep secret. Qing Tan arrives at the guild to say masked men are attacking the Lin Family. At home, Ghost Blade Sect leader Gui Yan forces Lin Zhentian to hand over the Yang Yuan Stone vein and then tries to kill everyone. Lin Dong kills Gui Yan with Huasheng Light, and the Lin Family no longer fears anyone in Yan City.
events: Master Yan waits 24 days while Lin Dong breaks through to 3rd Seal Symbol Master on the eighth floor.
Lin Dong tests Huasheng Light; his Destiny Symbol is drawn into a hidden space no one had entered in a hundred years.
Little Mink wakes up and explains the eight Ancestral Symbols.
An Ancestral Symbol rubbing marks two Ancestral Symbol locations on a map of the Great Yan Dynasty in Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol.
Qing Tan reaches the guild with news of an attack; Lin Dong leaves with Zi Yue.
Gui Yan takes the Yang Yuan Stone vein from Lin Zhentian, then tries to wipe out the Lin Family.
Lin Dong fights Gui Yan and kills him with Huasheng Light; the Ghost Blade Sect men flee.
cultivation: Lin Dong becomes a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Gui Yan is called Yan City's strongest at Yuan Dan advanced.
